resource: QUEST_LOG_QUERY commands (command type 22) of one GameSession
allocation_impact: A per-GameSession sliding window of at most 2 query instants in any 1 s, carried in the session continuity so a reconnect, resume or transfer never resets it. Each query reads the session copy once and sends one whole-domain delta of at most 180,268 bytes, so a session costs at most 2 projections and about 360 KB of deltas per second. An over-rate query has no effect and gets CommandStatus REJECTED with an empty payload.
boundary_tests: max=2: two queries in one second are served
max+1=3: a third query in the same second is REJECTED without effect, also after a reconnect; one a second later is served
notes: QUEST-GATE-0 §7 and §9 (the BAGS-WIRE-1b per-GameSession window); test: gameplay_transport::connection::quest_log::tests::queries_are_limited_to_2_per_second_per_game_session. Registered by OTV2-20261004-quest-log-wire-1.
